title: The window dies in the middle of a reply, then: resume
measures: a reply cut off by a crash is carried on from where it stood, not started over, and nothing done before the crash is lost or redone

turns.say: Every module in `kit/` has one bug; `python -m unittest discover tests` shows them. Fix the modules one at a time: fix one, run its own test file, then go on to the next.
turns.driver: kill the window once four or five modules are fixed
